notes: 7-inch wall-mount TouchLink Pro touchpanel (also mountable to furniture or rack accessory), not a rack-unit device — rackUnits omitted. Powered exclusively via PoE (802.3af, Class 3) through the single RJ-45 Ethernet port; there is no separate AC or DC power connector, so no dedicated power port is listed. The RJ-45 is rated 10/100/1000Base-T (gigabit-capable), hence eth-1g. USB port is a single Micro-B receptacle (USB 2.0 high-speed/480 Mbps host-adjacent port used for peripherals); modeled as usb-micro with usb-2.0 grade. The "digital input" is a 3.5 mm 2-pole captive screw (Euroblock-style) control/logic contact input (0-24 VDC, configurable), not an audio line-level jack — closest connector id is euroblock; no bandwidth grade applies. Unit has an internal mono speaker (89 dB SPL) for audio playback but no physical external audio output jack, so it is not listed as a port. Source is Extron's official specifications PDF (doc 6087-D5, covers TLP Pro 725M Series and TLS 725M); all values confirmed directly from this authoritative datasheet.
